quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single right lane to be used only for turning, a vehicle must: Be driven in the right turn lane only for the purpose of making a right turn.

activation.condition: Public highway with one exclusive right-turn lane; vehicle is driven within that lane.

obligation.description: Vehicle must be driven in that right-turn lane only for the purpose of making a right turn.

timing.description: Purpose is sourced before entry and evaluated over original lane-use interval; turn completion is a separate fact.

parameter_refs.name: declared_maneuver_purpose
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-declared right turn, through or left turn before lane entry

parameter_refs.name: requested_departure_route
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: connected right exit or independently sourced alternate exit
